description.value: Los Guerreros Latin Foods is a well-established Latin American grocery and prepared food market that has served Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley for over 30 years. The Kingsway location stocks authentic ingredients from Mexico, Colombia, El Salvador, Peru, Argentina, and beyond, including hard-to-find dried chile varieties, masa harina, and traditional seasonings. Cyclists stopping in will also find freshly made hot foods like tamales, pupusas, empanadas, and chimichangas.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 5m; stands (2 spaces) at 10m; stands (2 spaces) at 14m; stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (3 spaces) at 40m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Los Guerreros Latin Foods is a real, operating Latin American grocery and prepared food business with multiple Metro Vancouver locations including the Kingsway Vancouver address. The website content mentions fresh produce, groceries, and ready-to-eat/hot foods (tamales, empanadas, pupusas, chimichangas, sopes) but contains no mention of cyclist-specific amenities like bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or charging. OSM tags confirm phone and website match the website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Los Guerreros Mexican Food Products' but website branding is 'Los Guerreros Latin Foods' — the business serves broader Latin American cuisine, not just Mexican.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible grocery and prepared food business with over 30 years of operation and confirmed presence at this Kingsway address. Useful to touring cyclists seeking groceries and hot food.
